description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git diff' with various options such as -B, -M, and -C. It sets up test scenarios involving file modifications, renames, copies, and symbolic links, and compares the output of diffs against expected results to verify Git's diffing functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success and sets up or verifies Git diff scenarios.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Custom method to compare the actual diff output against the expected output.
